_readme: APGO monitoring thresholds. Secrets and account IDs stay in GitHub/Worker secrets; this file contains only non-sensitive behavior settings.

realtime._window_source: Rules read a settled 30-minute slot via runReport, not runRealtimeReport. The two pipelines disagree even with no lag (realtime was 36% above settled for the same window on 2026-09-20), and replaying the rule over 35 settled days gives one false alarm every 17.5 days against one every 3 in production. Lag is 120 rather than 90 because the 90-60 minute band was measured only half filled.

drop._retired: add_to_cart_drop and begin_checkout_drop were retired 2026-09-21. Replayed over 35 settled days: add_to_cart_drop fired 3 times (20260902-1800, 20260905-2000, 20260907-1930) and purchases held at or above the slot median through every one, with 500% and 600% windows immediately after; it also required current > 0, so add_to_cart at zero -- the failure that matters -- was the one case it could not report, and add_to_cart_zero already covers that. begin_checkout_drop fired 0 times in 35 days including both windows of the 2026-09-15 free-shipping incident. The incident signature was add_to_cart healthy with begin_checkout at zero, which is what the zero rules watch. Thresholds below are kept so the diagnostic can re-price the idea.

storefront_watch._readme: Synthetic checkout watch (scripts/storefront-watch.mjs). Every 20 minutes it adds a real product to an anonymous cart and asks /cart/shipping_rates.json for the investigator address. Public cart endpoints only: never the checkout page, never payment, never an order. It exists because Layer 4 now judges a settled GA4 window and takes about 2.5 hours; a cart that returns no shipping method is a fact and does not need settling.
storefront_watch._why_observe: Starts in observe so its first days are measured, not trusted. Arm it once the log shows it reporting ok on a store that was selling. The failure it watches for is deterministic, so once armed two consecutive failures 20 minutes apart is enough confirmation.

investigator._readme: Alert investigator (scripts/investigator.mjs). On the first page of an armed GA4 rule it adds each of the top add-to-cart products to an anonymous storefront cart, asks /cart/shipping_rates.json for this address, diffs against the daily snapshot and posts a silent 🔎 message. Public cart endpoints only: never the checkout page, never payment, never an order. Address supplied by Wade on 2026-09-15; Shopify requires the state for Malaysia.

orders._readme: Push-based order heartbeat in workers/error-monitor/orders.mjs (POST /orders/event from Shopify Flow, a WooCommerce webhook, or any backend); values mirror ORDER_LIMITS in workers/error-monitor/config.mjs. Mode is the Worker var ORDERS_MODE.
orders._threshold_evidence: 455 orders, 2026-09-09 to 09-20: median gap 19 min, p90 1h19m, longest healthy gap 5h51m; the only longer one, 8h01m, was the 09-15 free-shipping incident. Replayed over those days, 7 hours fires once (the incident) and 4 hours fires nine times on days confirmed healthy. Retune from observed_max_gap_minutes in the heartbeat, not by feel.
